name: Sergei Pavlovich

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (75 in height, 84 in reach, southpaw, born 1992-05-13). Weigh-in weight not looked up.

photo_coverage: Adequate. 10 photos. Frontal: ESPN studio headshot (May 2026). Three-quarter: a sharp 3000 px media-day photo (Jan 2025) and an old interview still (2018). Profile: left near-profiles at the May 2026 and Aug 2025 weigh-ins (video stills), right near-profile in the May 2026 fight photo. Body: studio cutouts from Aug 2025 and 2022, a back view (June 2024). No clean, sharp true profile. 2 files are CC BY; the rest are reference-only.

face.shape: Broad, square-to-round face, wide at the cheeks and jaw, with full cheeks; the face is wide relative to its height. Heavier in the lower half.
face.jaw: Wide and heavy with soft, rounded angles; some fullness under the chin; the jawline runs straight into a very thick neck.
face.chin: Broad and rounded, moderately projecting. No cleft.
face.cheekbones: Broad but not sharply defined; cheeks full, no hollows.
face.brow_ridge: Low to moderate; the brow area is smooth.
face.forehead: High, broad and smooth. Hairline straight across with mildly recessed temples.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium-small, slightly hooded upper lids and puffy lower lids. Outer corners level.
eyes.colour: Hazel: green-brown with an amber ring (ESPN headshot, Jan 2025 media photo).
eyes.size: Look small in the broad face.

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low, the outer ends tipping slightly down.
eyebrows.colour: Light brown, close to the hair.

nose.tip: Rounded and fleshy, pointing straight ahead.

mouth.width: Medium to slightly narrow for the face
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, corners level to slightly down; a faint half smile at media events.

ears.protrusion: Stand out moderately; obvious with the short crop.
ears.cauliflower_ear: None visible: normal folds frontally (ESPN) and in the Jan 2025 three-quarter view of the left ear.

face.notable_marks_scars: No large scars. A few small blemishes and faint marks on the forehead and cheeks in the high-resolution media photo; visible pores.

hair.style: Short crop: about 2.5-3 cm on top, pushed slightly forward and up at the front, tapered short (about 3-6 mm) on the sides and back. Same cut in 2018, 2022, 2024, 2025 and 2026.
hair.colour: Light brown to dark blond with a golden cast in warm light.
hair.hairline: Straight across with mild temple recession.

facial_hair.detail: Light stubble about 1-3 mm on the chin, jaw and upper lip (May 2026 studio); sometimes nearly clean-shaven (2018).
facial_hair.colour: Light brown with a reddish cast.
facial_hair.shape: Natural; covers the lower cheeks, jaw, chin and upper lip.

skin.tone_hex_method: Mean of the 7 samples not marked excluded (9x9-pixel medians).
skin.tone_note: Fair skin with a strong ruddy component. The warm indoor media photo pulls orange; the recommended value is nudged pinker and slightly lighter. Fight photos show him flushing deep red.
skin.undertone: Pink-ruddy; cheeks, nose and ears redden easily.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles seen. Little body hair on the chest and abdomen.
skin.texture_pick_reason: Age 34 maps to middleage; swatch #e8ccb2 is lighter than the target, so the multiply tint can reach #d98f78.

body.build: Big, thick heavyweight: 190.5 cm with exceptionally long arms (reach 213 cm, 23 cm more than his height). Powerful, heavy frame.
body.body_fat_notes: Smooth midsection with a soft lower belly; no visible abs in 2025-26 (faint upper abs in 2022).
body.shoulders: Very broad, with big, round deltoids and high, thick trapezius; the neck-to-shoulder line is short and steep.
body.chest: Thick and full, soft lower edge.
body.arms: Very long and thick: big biceps and triceps, heavy forearms.
body.waist: Thick; little V-taper from the front.
body.legs_calves: Thick thighs, solid calves; legs medium length relative to the long arms.
body.neck: Very thick and short, as wide as the jaw.
body.posture: Upright, shoulders slightly rounded forward, arms hanging slightly away from the body because of the lats and arm mass.
body.notable_physique_traits: Arm length and a very thick neck and shoulder girdle. No tattoos anywhere visible.

fight_posture.stance: Southpaw (fighters.json): right foot and right hand lead.
fight_posture.observed: Fight photos (UFC Macau May 2026, UFC Shanghai Aug 2025): fairly square, wide base, throws wide power punches with the non-punching glove dropped low near the chest; upright head.
fight_posture.confidence: Low to medium: two action stills.

tattoos.description: None: front of torso and arms clear in the 2022 and 2025 studio cutouts; back clear in the June 2024 face-off.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC Macau fight (May 2026): white UFC shorts with a light grey pattern and crypto.com logo; weigh-in in black and dark-red patterned shorts. Aug 2025 studio: black shorts with grey tiger-slash pattern and UFC SHANGHAI logo. 2022 studio: white and grey Venum shorts with red PAVLOVICH lettering.
kit.gloves: Black UFC gloves with red cuffs (May 2026).
kit.accessories_seen: Thin dark cord necklace at the May 2026 weigh-in.

render_hints.hair: hair-short04 (short crop) tinted #7a5434, or a light-brown scalp tint if the proxy reads too long

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Estimates for standard MakeHuman ear modifiers in case they are added.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, skin, no tattoos and build; medium for face proportions (one sharp frontal, one sharp three-quarter, profiles only from video stills); low-to-medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) Broad, full face with a wide, soft jaw and a neck as wide as the jaw; a narrow or angular face will look wrong. (2) Small, slightly hooded hazel eyes and thin, sparse light-brown brows. (3) Fair, ruddy skin: do not tan it. (4) The arms are much longer than his height suggests (reach 213 cm); make sure the reach-driven arm stretch is applied. (5) Southpaw: the right side leads, opposite to most of the roster. macro/ageOldM 0.138 follows avatar3d.js (34-25)/65; heightUpM 0.27 matches the 190.5 cm Ankalaev sheet.
